source:
@@U00050@@
No, Lord!
It was a mess to start with,
and it’s a mess still.
How I pity those poor people!
They're so miserable.
I haven't the heart to plague them, poor things.

@@U00052@@
Do you know 浮士德?

@@U00054@@
The doctor?

@@U00056@@
He's my servant.

@@U00058@@
Servant! Well!
He certainly has an odd way of serving!
No earthly food or drink for that fool!
The ferment in him has driven him so far
that he almost half knows his folly.
He demands of heaven its fairest star,
and of earth its wildest abandon.
Nothing, near or far, ever satisfies him.

@@U00060@@
He may be confused at present,
but I'll soon lead him into the light.
The gardener knows that when the tree turns green
blossoms and fruit can’t be far behind.

@@U00062@@
What will you wager?
You'll lose him yet, you will, if you allow me
to lead him gently down my primrose path.
translation:
@@U00050@@
不，主啊！
一开始就很混乱
现在还是一团糟。
我多么可怜那些可怜的人啊！
他们太惨了
我不忍心去折磨他们，可怜的东西。

@@U00052@@
你知道浮士德吗？

@@U00054@@
医生？

@@U00056@@
他是我的仆人。

@@U00058@@
仆人！出色地！
他的服务方式确实很奇怪！
那个傻瓜没有世间的食物或饮料！
他体内的发酵推动他到目前为止
他几乎知道自己的愚蠢行为了一半。
他要求天堂拥有最美丽的星星，
以及地球上最疯狂的遗弃。
没有什么，无论远近，都不能令他满意。

@@U00060@@
他现在可能很困惑，
但我很快就会带领他走向光明。
园丁知道当树变绿时
开花结果也不远。

@@U00062@@
你会打赌什么？
你还是会失去他，你会的，如果你允许的话
轻轻地引导他走上我的报春花之路。
